name: claude_p11_smart_loot (B10/B11 human: Follow NPC opens an untouched generated container and drains it into its bag; DEBUG rbp11 hook; NOT RUN)
classification: FIXTURE-DEPENDENT; needs the DEBUG rbp11 hook (Scripts/NPC/SmartLooting/RebirthP11FixtureCommands.cs) and a CodexTest save. Every assertion is a positive expectLog over [RBP11] lines; nothing is asserted from unsupported step types.
_fixture: SAVE: authoritative disposable save named CodexTest, Smart Looting option ON.

NPC: a hired human NPC in Follow order, empty bag, standing within RebirthCompanionService.StorageDistance of container C. Replace the token NPCID in this file with its entity id (find/replace; tokens are deliberately non-numeric so an unedited file fails loudly).

C: an UNTOUCHED, empty, generated loot container with a loot list (tokens CX CY CZ). S: the owner named storage with free cells (SX SY SZ). L: a container locked by another owner (LX LY LZ), untouched. All are literal tokens to replace because the runner has no variable substitution.
_limits: Conservation is by item-name totals (rbp11 mark/conserve), not exact ItemValue frames.
mark grid_after_open is taken when the open receipt reaches phase 1; a leg that already ran before it is excluded from the delta by the bag1/storage1 baselines taken in the same console step batch.
Search time is ScavengingTime-scaled, so the waits below are generous polls, not exact.

steps._note: 1. Defaults are OFF and arming needs the guard plus confirm.
2. Arm exactly the four gates the NPC-opened Follow loot path needs: generated incarnation, NPC-attributed open, Follow dispatcher, unified ordering (the NPC leg selector is inert without it).
3. PRE: container untouched and empty, no receipts, baselines for the NPC bag and owner storage; L untouched.
4. ACT 1: the Follow NPC searches, opens (no owner activation, so no proxy attribution) and the receipt reaches phase 1 with effects applied. Generous polling.
5. ACT 2: exact one-stack legs run until the container is drained or the bag is full. Poll the pending set.
6. CONSERVATION: grid_after_open == container now + (bag now - bag1) + (storage now - storage1), by item-name totals.

steps.console: rbp11 conserve grid_after_open grid:CX:CY:CZ bag:NPCID:bag1 grid:SX:SY:SZ:storage1

steps._note: 7. NO REROLL: time passes with the container still touched; the open receipt count stays 1 and conservation still holds.

steps.console: rbp11 conserve grid_after_open grid:CX:CY:CZ bag:NPCID:bag1 grid:SX:SY:SZ:storage1

steps._note: 8. NATIVE RULES: the container locked by another owner stays untouched.
